archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.3 Implement Data and Metadata Governance
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once frameworks are in place, the organization puts governance into action by managing data and metadata consistently. This includes establishing data catalogues, defining naming conventions, maintaining reference data, and tracking data lineage.
Each dataset is registered with metadata describing its source, transformations, and usage restrictions. Stewards ensure that metadata remains complete, accurate, and up to date.
By doing so, data becomes discoverable, understandable, and traceable, supporting both operational efficiency and auditability.
Value created: Transparent and well-managed data and metadata that support reusability and accountability.
